dialogue.content: (お時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ、相談員です。はじめに、あなたの年齢、性別と、相談内容を教えて下さい、
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 58さい女性最近死ぬのが怖いです
dialogue.English: I'm a 58-year-old woman, and lately, I've been afraid of dying.

dialogue.content: 死ぬのが怖いというお気持ちになることが、おありなんですね。
dialogue.English: So you’ve been feeling afraid of dying.

dialogue.content: はい、病気になってしまったらどうしようと不安です。どう生きていけば気がラクになりますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m anxious about what I would do if I became ill. How can I live so that I can feel more at ease?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね‥病気になってしまうことに対して、怖いお気持ちがおありになるんですね。そのことで、生きているのが楽ではないと、感じていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... You feel scared about the possibility of getting sick. And because of that, you feel that living isn't easy.

dialogue.content: 生きていくのは楽ではない・・・そう感じながら毎日過ごされるのは、お辛いですよね‥
dialogue.English: "Living isn't easy"... It must be difficult to go through each day feeling that way.

dialogue.content: 生きていくのがラクではないというか、病気が怖いです
dialogue.English: It's not so much that living isn't easy, but rather that I'm scared of getting sick.

dialogue.content: 辛いじゃなくて不安です
dialogue.English: It's not that it's difficult; I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね‥とても不安に思っていらっしゃるんですね。病気が怖い、というお気持ちになられた、きっかけが、なにかございましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... You're feeling very anxious. Was there anything in particular that triggered this fear of illness?

dialogue.content: 周りの人が病気になったり有名人が亡くなると自分もかなと、怖くなります
dialogue.English: When people around me get sick or celebrities pass away, I get scared, thinking it could happen to me too.

dialogue.content: 毎日そればかり考えてしまうのが自分でも嫌ですが頭からはなれなくなるのです
dialogue.English: I don't like that I think about it every day, but I can't get it out of my head.

dialogue.content: 病気の事が頭から離れず、不安になってしまわれるんですね。病気のことが頭に浮かんでいる時、他に、どんな考えがうかんでいらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So thoughts about illness won’t leave your mind, and you become anxious. When those thoughts come up, what other thoughts arise for you?

dialogue.content: 死にたくないとか
dialogue.English: Things like, “I don’t want to die.”

dialogue.content: ずっと生きていたい、家族と別れたくないと思います
dialogue.English: I want to live forever, and I don't want to be separated from my family.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。死ぬことへの不安が、ご自身の中で大きくなられるのですね。ご家族と一緒に、まだまだ、ずっとお過ごしになりたいというお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. The fear of dying is growing larger within you. You feel that you want to spend much, much more time with your family.

dialogue.content: はい、ずっと子どもを見ていたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to watch over my children forever.

dialogue.content: 成長を見ていたい、お子様がいらっしゃるのですね。お子様はお幾つでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: You have children, and you want to see them grow. How old are your children?

dialogue.content: おおきいですが、何歳になっても心配で
dialogue.English: They're grown up, but no matter how old they get, I still worry about them.

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分の子供は、幾つになっても、母親にとっては、幼い頃の感覚と変わらないといいますね。
dialogue.English: That's true. They say that to a mother, her children always feel the same as when they were little, no matter how old they get.

dialogue.content: 健康で長生きして子どもを見ていたいので
dialogue.English: I want to be healthy and live a long life so I can continue to watch over my children.

dialogue.content: でも病気ってなるときはなるし、ならない秘訣がないので何していいかわからない
dialogue.English: But illness happens when it happens, and there's no secret to avoiding it, so I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ずっと健康で、お子様たちの人生を見届けていたいですよね。でも、病気になることが避けられない、病気にならない秘訣がないと思っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You want to stay healthy and watch over your children's lives. But at the same time, you feel that getting sick is unavoidable and there's no secret to preventing it.

dialogue.content: はい、何かありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes. Is there anything I can do?

dialogue.content: そうですね・・ネットなどでも、色々な情報が飛び交っていますよね。
dialogue.English: Well... there's all sorts of information flying around on the internet and elsewhere, isn't there?

dialogue.content: はい。なるべく病気になりたくないです
dialogue.English: Yes. I want to avoid getting sick as much as possible.

dialogue.content: 今、どこか、お体で不安なところがおありですか？
dialogue.English: Are there any parts of your body that you're worried about right now?

dialogue.content: 今は特にないのですが
dialogue.English: Not particularly at the moment, but...

dialogue.content: 年齢がいい歳なので不安で
dialogue.English: I'm at that age where I'm starting to worry.

dialogue.content: 今は、お体の事でのご心配はないのですね。それは、とても安心ですね。
dialogue.English: So you don't have any concerns about your body right now. That's very reassuring, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s true.

dialogue.content: たしかに
dialogue.English: Indeed.

dialogue.content: 健康診断を受ける前は悪いことばかり考えてしまって
dialogue.English: Before a health checkup, I can't help but think of all the bad things that could happen.

dialogue.content: 憂鬱になります
dialogue.English: and it makes me feel gloomy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。悪いところが見つからないかと不安になり、憂鬱になってしまわれるんですね…今、ご心配なところがないということは、これから病気にならないような予防策が、たくさんあると安心ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You worry about them finding something wrong, and that makes you feel anxious and gloomy. Since you don't have any specific worries right now, it's reassuring that there are many preventive measures you can take to avoid getting sick in the future.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 運動とかしてないので不安になるのかも
dialogue.English: Maybe I get anxious because I don’t exercise or do other things like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご自身の中で、運動が足りていないというお考えがおありなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that you're not getting enough exercise.

dialogue.content: 心配ばかりしてて行動してないから不安になるのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if I get anxious because I'm just worrying and not taking any action.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは何か運動してますか？運動嫌いな人は何をするのがいいですかね？
dialogue.English: Do you do any exercise, counselor? What do you think would be good for someone who dislikes exercise?

dialogue.content: ご自身で、そう思われるんですね。行動できないから、より心配になってしまわれると。
dialogue.English: So you feel that way yourself. That because you're not taking action, you become even more worried.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 運動嫌いなんですよいろいろやったけどつづかなくて
dialogue.English: I dislike exercise. I've tried various things, but I can never stick with them.

dialogue.content: そうですね・・私は、あまりたいそうなことをしておりませんが、周囲の方で、健康に気を付けていらっしゃる方は、電車移動の際に、わざわざ人駅前で降りて歩かれる方がいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: Let's see... I don't do anything too strenuous myself, but some health-conscious people I know make a point of getting off the train one stop early to walk.

dialogue.content: 専業主婦で電車つかわないんです
dialogue.English: I’m a full-time homemaker, so I don’t use the train.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。これまで、どんな運動をためされたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of exercise have you tried so far?

dialogue.content: ヨガやテニス、フラダンスなどやりましたが面倒くさくなり辞めました
dialogue.English: I tried things like yoga, tennis, and hula dancing, but they started to feel like a hassle, so I quit.

dialogue.content: 色々、頑張って挑戦なさったんですね。
dialogue.English: You really put in the effort to try a lot of different things.

dialogue.content: 成果が見えないとつまらないんですよ
dialogue.English: It's no fun if I can't see any results.

dialogue.content: 挑戦するのは好きですが、楽しいなとおもえなくて
dialogue.English: I like trying new things, but I just couldn't find them enjoyable.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・成果が見える方が、やる気が出て続く感じがしていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so you feel that you're more motivated and able to continue when you can see the results.

dialogue.content: 何がいいのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder what would be good...

dialogue.content: あと、自分が下手くそすぎると気が引けてしまって、いやになって辞めてしまうかも
dialogue.English: Also, if I’m too bad at it, I start to feel self-conscious, get discouraged, and end up quitting.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えてみますね。そうですね・・具体的に、どんな成果が見えると良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Let's think about it together. Specifically, what kind of visible results would be good to see?

dialogue.content: やせたりとか、かな
dialogue.English: Losing weight, perhaps.

dialogue.content: 体が締まってくるとか
dialogue.English: Or getting more toned.

dialogue.content: なるほど！体系の変化が目に見えたりすると、やる気が出てきますね！
dialogue.English: I see! When you can visually see changes in your body shape, that's very motivating!

dialogue.content: はい、何か見えるとやる気出ます
dialogue.English: Yes, when I can see a change, I get motivated.

dialogue.content: 最近腰痛もあって
dialogue.English: I’ve also had some lower back pain lately.

dialogue.content: 太り過ぎかも
dialogue.English: Maybe I'm overweight.

dialogue.content: 上達に時間がかかると、なかなか成果を実感できなかったんでしたね。腰痛はお辛いですよね・・・そうなると、もしかして、シンプルな運動を続けられて、腰に負担がかからない運動が良さそうですね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned it was hard to feel the results when it took a long time to improve. And back pain is tough... In that case, maybe a simple exercise that you can stick with and that doesn't strain your lower back would be good.

dialogue.content: はい！何かありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes! Is there anything like that?

dialogue.content: そうですね・・どのような動きだったら、腰にご負担がかからなくて済みそうですか？
dialogue.English: Let's see... what kind of movements do you think wouldn't put a strain on your back?

dialogue.content: なんでしょうかね？
dialogue.English: I wonder what that would be.

dialogue.content: 私も詳しくなくて
dialogue.English: I don't know much about it either.

dialogue.content: 体系の変化が見えると、成果を感じられて長続きしそうって、仰ってましたね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned that seeing changes in your body shape would help you feel the results and stick with it, didn't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一般的には、シェイプアップには、有酸素運動が良いと言われていますね。
dialogue.English: Generally, aerobic exercise is said to be good for shaping up.

dialogue.content: 歩いたり走ったりですか？
dialogue.English: Like walking or running?

dialogue.content: 他にもいろいろありそうですが、日常的に運動なさる場合、屋外と屋内では、どちらが続けられそうってお考えですか？
dialogue.English: There are many other options, of course, but if you were to exercise regularly, do you think you'd be more likely to stick with it outdoors or indoors?

dialogue.content: 屋外が好きですがこれから暑くなるので室内かな
dialogue.English: I like being outdoors, but since it’s going to get hot soon, I'm thinking indoors.

dialogue.content: そうですね。確かに、これから外は暑くなってしまいますね。屋内のジムや、プールに行くという手もありますし、ご自宅でされるという方法もあると思うのですが、どんな場所でされるのが楽しそうですか？
dialogue.English: That's true. It certainly will get hot outside soon. There's the option of going to an indoor gym or a pool, or you could do something at home. What kind of place seems like it would be most enjoyable for you?

dialogue.content: みんなが頑張ってる場所がいいかなあ
dialogue.English: A place where everyone else is working hard might be good.

dialogue.content: プールもいいですね！
dialogue.English: A pool sounds good, too!

dialogue.content: プールにしようかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I'll go with the pool.

dialogue.content: なるほど！他の方も同じように頑張っている姿が見える方がよさそうなんですね。プールはこれからの季節気持ちがよさそうですね。
dialogue.English: I see! So it sounds like it's better for you to see other people working hard, too. A pool would feel great in the coming season.

dialogue.content: はいいいアイデアいただきました
dialogue.English: Yes, you've given me a great idea.

dialogue.content: それに、水泳は有酸素運動ですね！
dialogue.English: And what's more, swimming is an aerobic exercise!

dialogue.content: そうですね！ちょうどいいですね
dialogue.English: That's right! It's perfect.

dialogue.content: なんかワクワクしてきました
dialogue.English: I'm starting to get excited.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。私までなんだかワクワクしてきました。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. You're making me feel excited, too.

dialogue.content: 病気が少し怖くなくなりました
dialogue.English: I'm a little less scared of getting sick now.

dialogue.content: 水泳は好きでした
dialogue.English: I used to like swimming.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは本当に良かったです。水泳は元々お好きだったんですね。昔、やっていらっしゃったんですか？
dialogue.English: Is that so? I'm really glad to hear that. So you liked swimming to begin with. Did you used to do it?

dialogue.content: 習ったことはないですが、小学生の頃水泳選手に選ばれたこともあります。運動嫌いだけど唯一好きかも
dialogue.English: I've never taken lessons, but I was chosen for the swim team in elementary school. I dislike exercise, but this might be the one thing I actually like.

dialogue.content: 習ってないのに、水泳選手に選ばれるなんて、本当にすごいです！
dialogue.English: Being chosen for the swim team without ever taking lessons is really amazing!

dialogue.content: 多分水泳が好きだったんです。私昔から好きなことしかできないタイプで。
dialogue.English: I think I just really liked swimming. I've always been the type of person who can only do things they enjoy.

dialogue.content: 好きっていえる運動があることが、ちょっぴりうらやましいです。
dialogue.English: I'm a little envious that you have an exercise you can say you like.

dialogue.content: 最近無理やりいやなことをしていたかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe I've been forcing myself to do things I dislike lately.

dialogue.content: 好きなことを選べばいいですね！
dialogue.English: I can just choose to do what I like!

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。好きな事しかできないって思っていらっしゃるのに、無理やり嫌なことをされているのは苦しかったですね‥これからは好きなことを、思いっきりなさって欲しいです。
dialogue.English: I see. Even though you feel you can only do things you enjoy, you were forcing yourself to do things you dislike. That must have been painful. From now on, I hope you'll do what you love to your heart's content.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そう言ってもらえて嬉しいそんなこと言われたことなかったので
dialogue.English: Thank you! I'm so happy to hear you say that. No one has ever said that to me before.

dialogue.content: 苦しかったです
dialogue.English: It was painful.

dialogue.content: 好きなことしている時が、一番身体がよろこんでいる感じがしますよね？
dialogue.English: Don't you feel like your body is happiest when you're doing something you love?

dialogue.content: そうですよね元々そういう人間でした
dialogue.English: That's right. I've always been that kind of person.

dialogue.content: 忘れてました
dialogue.English: I had forgotten.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、心が苦しくていらっしゃたから、身体の事も不安になられたのかもしれませんね‥
dialogue.English: Perhaps because your heart was in pain, you started to feel anxious about your body as well.

dialogue.content: そうかも
dialogue.English: That might be it.

dialogue.content: 好きなことを思いっきりされていいと思います。そのことで、あなたが生き生きと笑っていらっしゃる方が、きっとご家族もうれしいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think it's perfectly fine to immerse yourself in what you love. I'm sure your family would be happier to see you lively and smiling, don't you think?

dialogue.content: 毎日子どもと夫のごはんの献立ばかり気にして、自分優先でありませんでした
dialogue.English: Every day I was just worried about planning meals for my children and husband; I wasn't prioritizing myself.

dialogue.content: そうですか？家事やらないと責められる気がしてしまって
dialogue.English: Do you really think so? I feel like I’ll be blamed if I don’t do the housework.

dialogue.content: あなたが、それだけご家族をとても大事にしていらっしゃるからですね。
dialogue.English: That’s because you care so deeply for your family.

dialogue.content: 役目かと思ってました
dialogue.English: I thought it was my duty.

dialogue.content: 家事をやらないと責められる、自分の役目だからって、思われていたんですね。
dialogue.English: So you felt that you would be blamed if you didn't do the housework, and that it was your duty.

dialogue.content: 義母や旦那に仕事してないのに家事もしないなんて思われそうで怖いです
dialogue.English: I’m afraid my mother-in-law and husband will think, “She doesn’t work, and she doesn’t even do the housework.”

dialogue.content: そう思われると、好きなこともできないお気持ちになられるんですね。
dialogue.English: When you worry they might think that, it makes you feel like you can't do the things you enjoy.

dialogue.content: 義母や旦那に怒られそうで
dialogue.English: I'm afraid my mother-in-law and husband will get angry with me.

dialogue.content: そう思われる不安と、今日までの病気に対する不安とどちらが苦しそうですか？
dialogue.English: Which feels more painful: the anxiety about them thinking that, or the anxiety about illness that you've felt up to now?

dialogue.content: 義母は恩着せがましいひとなので。同じくらいかな
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law is the type of person who always makes you feel indebted to her. So, I guess they're about the same.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。では、家事に支障がでないペースで、プールに行かれるのはできそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, do you think you could go to the pool at a pace that won't interfere with your housework?

dialogue.content: はい、昼間誰もいない時に行けそうです。明日から行ってみます！
dialogue.English: Yes, I can go during the day when no one is home. I'll try going, starting tomorrow!

dialogue.content: 是非、そうされるのが良いと思います。今日はお時間になってしまいましたが、また是非ご相談にいらして下さい。
dialogue.English: I think that would be a great idea. Our time is up for today, but please feel free to come back for another session anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: あなたが楽しくプールが良いできるように、応援させていただきます。本日はありがとうございました。これで失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: I'll be cheering for you to enjoy the pool. Thank you for your time today. I'll sign off now.

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)
